title: Painter Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for painting jobs — surface prep, interior painting, paint and primer, labor and supplies. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Scope per the signed estimate; paint colors and sheens as confirmed before work began.
features: Auto-calculating totals and tax in Excel
Pre-filled painter line items: surface prep, interior paint, paint and primer by gallon, labor, supplies
Net-14 payment terms and late-fee line standard for painting invoices
License # field — many states require a contractor license on client-facing invoices

faqs.q: What should I include on a painter invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list (prep, paint, primer, labor, supplies), payment terms and due date. Reference the signed estimate for scope.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate totals automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, tax and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
